notes: Stories refined for clarity, no new IDs created per dedup rules.

change_log.value: Clarified schema to explicitly include recruiting filter, normalized location structure, and optional travel enrichment flag in contract.
Expanded to include normalization of ClinicalTrials.gov fields and resilience to partial/missing data in API response.
Clarified enrichment is conditional and must gracefully degrade when routing API fails or location is missing.
Explicitly includes tool_router validation and alignment with Anthropic tool-use contract.
Expanded to require mocking of external APIs and coverage for degraded paths (no results, partial data, routing failure).

EVAL-F-001-S1.title: Define Clinical Trials Search Schema and Contract
EVAL-F-001-S1.description: Define request/response schema for clinical trials search including condition, location, recruiting status filter, structured trial fields (id, title, phase, status, locations), eligibility summary, normalized location structure, and optional travel enrichment flag.

EVAL-F-001-S2.title: Implement ClinicalTrials.gov Search Logic
EVAL-F-001-S2.description: Implement backend service to query ClinicalTrials.gov with recruiting filter, normalize and map API response into structured schema, extract trial locations and eligibility summaries, and handle partial or missing data gracefully.

EVAL-F-001-S3.title: Add Travel Distance and Time Enrichment
EVAL-F-001-S3.description: Integrate Google Routes to compute travel distance and duration from user location to trial sites, append enrichment to each trial location, and gracefully degrade when routing data or user location is unavailable.

EVAL-F-001-S4.title: Expose Clinical Trials Search via Evaluate Care Facade
EVAL-F-001-S4.description: Expose clinical trials search through evaluate_care_facade and tool_router, ensuring Pydantic-validated inputs, Anthropic tool-use compliance, and structured outputs (including optional travel enrichment) are returned to the chat layer.

EVAL-F-001-S5.title: Unit and Integration Tests for Clinical Trials Search
EVAL-F-001-S5.description: Create unit tests for schema validation and service logic, plus integration tests covering facade invocation, tool routing, mocked ClinicalTrials.gov API interaction, and travel enrichment including degraded paths (no results, partial data, routing failure).
EVAL-F-001-S5.evidence: GAP: No existing test file for clinical trials; must be created under backend/tests/
